title: Sync jobs
subtitle: Every exchange with a device — attendance pulls, employee pushes, health checks and reconciliations.

jobs.emptyHint: Jobs appear here when devices are synced manually, on schedule or by a push terminal.
jobs.emptyDeviceHint: No sync job has touched this device yet.
jobs.live: Live — refreshing while jobs are running

detail.title: Sync job
detail.itemsEmptyHint: This job did not produce any per-device or per-employee work items.
detail.retryHint: A new job is created with the failed and offline items of active devices. The original job is kept for reference.
detail.cancelHint: Pending and queued items are cancelled; items already running finish on their own.

dialog.attendanceHint: Pull new punches from the selected devices. Only pull-capable, active devices are included.
dialog.employeesHint: Push employee records (name, card, PIN) to devices. Biometric templates are never sent from the cloud.
dialog.allDevicesHint: Every active device of the organisation (within your branch scope).
dialog.allEmployeesHint: Every active employee, pushed to the devices of their branch.
dialog.devicesForEmployeesHint: Optional — otherwise employees go to every employee-push device of their branch.
dialog.fullResyncHint: Re-pull from the earliest cursor. Duplicates are ignored; use it after a device reset or a suspected gap.
dialog.removeStaleHint: Also delete users that should no longer exist on the device (terminated or moved employees).

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.subtitle: Compare the cloud roster with each device's user list and unmatched punches; repair pushes the differences.
reconciliation.cloudOnlyHint: Employees expected on the device but missing
reconciliation.deviceOnlyHint: Users on the device with no matching employee
reconciliation.differingHint: Records whose device copy differs from the cloud
reconciliation.staleHint: Employees on the device that should have been removed
reconciliation.unmatchedHint: Raw punches that could not be attributed to an employee
reconciliation.runAllHint: One reconciliation item per active device is queued. Nothing is changed on the devices.
reconciliation.repairAllHint: After comparing, a repair job pushes missing employees and removes device-only or stale users on every device.
reconciliation.repairHint: Missing and differing employees are pushed; device-only and stale users are removed from the device.
